questionText:
An arithmetic sequence has first term $a = 4$ and common difference $d = 3$.

(a) Write down the first four terms of the sequence.
(b) Find $T_{20}$, the $20$th term of the sequence.
markingScheme:
(a) Correct first four terms $4, 7, 10, 13$ **(2 marks)**
(b) State general formula $T_n = a + (n - 1)d$ **(1 mark)**
(b) Substitute $a = 4$, $d = 3$, $n = 20$ **(1 mark)**
(b) Final answer $T_{20} = 61$ **(1 mark)**

solutionSteps.explanation: Start from $a = 4$ and add $d = 3$ each time: $4,\; 7,\; 10,\; 13$.
